description: Muraro, Fabio at University of Sheffield publishes experimental results on soluble contaminants released from surcharging sewers through Co-UDlabs. The Mignot campaign characterises exchange between sewer infrastructure and shallow floodwater. Native file descriptors include MATLAB data named for colour, temperature and surface PIV, plus a salt-data CSV and the experimental storage report. Coverage is the Sheffield A/B flume campaign; detailed experiment durations and spatial sampling are not stated. Zenodo provides MATLAB MAT files, a CSV and a PDF report with free access under CC BY 4.0. These observations support the source-defined drainage measurement, physical-model or simulation activity. Related Co-UDlabs experiments describe other assets and test conditions; they are not assumed to be independent or interchangeable measurements. A limitation is file names do not establish array structure, calibration coefficients or complete pollutant mass balances. Only native metadata and file descriptors were read; no data values, archive, code or report body was obtained.
